note.question: When may Medicare Advantage plans offer nonmedical supplemental benefits, how do capitation payments change the insurer's choice between preventive and general-well-being services, beneficiary selection, and welfare?
note.overview: The paper explicitly models a sequential interaction among the regulator, a Medicare Advantage insurer, and heterogeneous beneficiaries; the insurer's plan and charge are solved anticipating enrollment, and the regulator can in turn anticipate the downstream equilibrium.

coverage.note: The existing independently audited model map was decomposed into Mini-style components and linked back to the page-preserving source extraction.
